sandbachFocus: League leaders Sandbach United host Alsager Town on Saturday at 15:00, looking to bounce back from their most recent loss. Sandbach sit top with 22 points from 10 games and have won seven of their last six matches (with only the most recent result being a defeat), so they remain strong contenders despite the setback. Alsager arrive in poor form, winless in their last five games and anchored near the bottom of the table with just 4 points from 10 matches.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town travel to Dawley Town in a fixture with title-race implications, as Stafford sit just two points behind the leaders with a recent loss in their form. AFC Bridgnorth (3rd) host Eccleshall (5th) in an intriguing mid-table clash between two strong performers. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, face Wednesfield Community at home, with the Casuals looking to consolidate their position after recent wins. Bilston Town (6th, 17 points) visit Foley Meir in a battle involving a team on good recent form against opponents struggling with inconsistency. Barnton host Shawbury United—a concerning fixture for Shawbury, who are on a concerning six-game losing streak and will visit an in-form Barnton side. In-form New Mills travel to Market Drayton Town, where the hosts will hope to end a recent poor run. Crewe face Allscott Heath at home in a clash between lower-mid-table teams, while Cheadle Heath Nomads host Telford Town in a fixture between two struggling sides near the foot of the table. Brereton Social face winless Widnes Town at home—a critical opportunity for Brereton to climb the table against the division's lowest-placed club.
